question_en:
The editorial team is documenting changes in the weather system shown in the image. Starting from the first record on June 29 in the column for public advisories in the image, review the corresponding official advisories one by one in chronological order as listed in that column, without skipping any records. When the maximum sustained winds recorded in an advisory first reach or exceed **80 mph**, include that advisory in the results and then stop. Please answer the following questions:
1. List the advisory number, UTC time, and full title for each advisory in the order accessed, and transcribe the complete original lines recording the center location (latitude/longitude) and maximum sustained winds.
2. Compared to the starting advisory, which advisory's title first changed the designation of the weather system category? Provide the advisory number.
3. How many different official advisory pages were verified in total?

Answer Format: Please answer in points numbered (1)–(3); for Question 1, use a table to list the requested fields item by item, preserving the original lines; for Question 2, provide the advisory number in text; for Question 3, provide the total number of pages in text.

| 2 | 3 | 2024-06-29 0900 | Tropical Storm Beryl Advisory Number 3 | LOCATION...9.8N 45.5W | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...50 MPH...85 KM/H |
| 3 | 3a | 2024-06-29 1200 | Tropical Storm Beryl Intermediate Advisory Number 3A...Corrected | LOCATION...9.8N 46.8W | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...60 MPH...95 KM/H |
| 4 | 4 | 2024-06-29 1500 | Tropical Storm Beryl Advisory Number 4 | LOCATION...10.0N 47.8W | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...65 MPH...100 KM/H |
| 5 | 4a | 2024-06-29 1800 | Tropical Storm Beryl Intermediate Advisory Number 4A | LOCATION...10.0N 48.4W | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...65 MPH...100 KM/H |
| 6 | 5 | 2024-06-29 2100 | Hurricane Beryl Advisory Number 5 | LOCATION...10.1N 49.3W | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...75 MPH...120 KM/H |
| 7 | 5a | 2024-06-30 0000 | Hurricane Beryl Intermediate Advisory Number 5A | LOCATION...10.2N 50.3W | MAXIMUM SUSTAINED WINDS...80 MPH...130 KM/H |

(2) Advisory Number 5.

(3) A total of 7 different official announcement pages were verified.
